name: Podman
shortDescription: Daemonless, rootless container engine — Docker-compatible CLI without the root-owned daemon.
description: Podman is a container engine that runs OCI containers without a central root-owned daemon: containers run as ordinary user processes, rootless by default, with a CLI that's drop-in familiar to anyone who knows Docker. That security posture matters most exactly where we use containers — sandboxing services and agent workloads on shared development machines — and pods give it a natural on-ramp to Kubernetes shapes when needed.
useCases: Rootless containers for services on shared development VMs
Docker-compatible workflows without a privileged daemon
Local pods that mirror Kubernetes deployment shapes
